body.heading: Where in the world is Ghana?
paragraphs: Ghana is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Ghana is Accra.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Ghana is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Ghana is the Ghanaian cedi.

body.heading: How big is Ghana?
paragraphs: Ghana covers about 239,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Cameroon.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: At Kakum you can walk on rope bridges strung high in the rainforest canopy, looking down on giant trees and out for monkeys and hornbills.
This white seaside castle is beautiful and sobering at once — its museum helps families understand the history of the transatlantic slave trade.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Ghana on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Ghana in one breath: a country in Western Africa, capital Accra, where people speak English and pay with the Ghanaian cedi.
